page.overview:
What is Planet?

The world of the Final Fantasy VII series is simply known as the planet Final Fantasy VII Remake does not capitalize the name, treating it as a common noun.}}. The world has been called Gaia, in marketing materials though not in the games themselves, though a location named Gaea's Cliff exists in the original Final Fantasy VII. The study of planetology posits that the planet itself is a living organism and could be sentient to some extent.

Bugenhagen's planetarium shows the planets of the Solar System and implies that the planet where the Final Fantasy VII series takes place is in place of Earth, while Safer∙Sephiroth's Supernova ability, in versions after the original Japanese release specifically, name the other planets after the planets in the real world Earth's solar system. The planet of Final Fantasy VII has a moon that is slightly smaller in size than Meteor.

The planet is made up of three unnamed continents: one in the east, one in the west, and one in the north. Other large islands include the Mideel island south of the eastern continent part of a long chain of islands, a large forested island that holds the Temple of the Ancients in the southwest of the eastern continent, and a long island of Wutai to the west of the western continent that is home to Wutai Village. Most of the planet has a temperate climate with large grassy plains broken up by mountains.

The Icicle Area taking up the northern continent is made up of a massive plain of ice known as the Great Glacier. At the northern tip of the landmass is the gigantic North Crater that has a cave inside known as the Northern Cave, which leads into the bowels of the planet. The most prominent desert is on the western continent below the Gold Saucer. Marshlands can be found on the eastern continent in front of the Mythril Mine in the Grasslands Area.
